title.en: An Act Appropriating Additional Funds for the Philippine Veterans Administration
title.orig: An Act Appropriating Additional Funds for the Philippine Veterans Administration

text.en:
The sum of five million pesos is approved, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, as additional funds to be expended by the Philippine Veterans Administration for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and sixty-nine, as follows:
1. To implement the Educational Benefits Program as provided for by Republic Act No. 65, as amended ₱4,500,000
2. To pay pensions and death gratuities as provided for by Republic Act No. 610 500,000 Total ₱5,000,000

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
